items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: They just did a great thing with Wycliffe Gordon, and they have no prejudices.

ctx.x: And there again, they’re trying to record the entire spectrum of the music. They just did a great thing with Wycliffe Gordon, and they have no prejudices. They like good musicians and good music. Again I can’t say enough good things — it’s another thing that I consider myself a very lucky person to have met them.

Do you do a certain amount of your own promotion to try to keep your name — I mean even like a place like this — do you try to make sure that the promoter doesn’t forget about you or is it not necessary? Do you think you’re in the circuit enough that —
